title: Pentagon strikes classified AI deals with OpenAI, Google, and Nvidia — but not Anthropic
raw_excerpt: The Pentagon has struck deals with OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Nvidia, Elon Musk's xAI, and the startup Reflection, allowing the agency to use their AI tools in classified settings, according to an announcement on Friday . At the same time, the Defense Department has left out Anthropic - which it previously used for classified information - after declaring it a supply-chain risk. This builds upon deals with OpenAI and xAI , which have already reached agreements with the Pentagon for the "lawful" use of their AI systems. summary: 五角大楼宣布与 OpenAI、谷歌、英伟达、微软、亚马逊、xAI 及 Reflection 等七家 AI 公司达成协议，允许其在机密环境中使用 AI 工具。Anthropic 因被认定为供应链风险而被排除在外。此举标志着美国国防部加速将前沿 AI 集成至国家安全体系，同时引发对 AI 军事化应用的争议。

title: Musk v. Altman week 1: Elon Musk says he was duped, warns AI could kill us all, and admits that xAI distills OpenAI’s models
raw_excerpt: In the first week of the landmark trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk took the stand in a crisp black suit and tie and argued that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman had deceived him into bankrolling the company. Along the way, he warned that AI could destroy us all and sat through revelations that he had poached OpenAI employees for his own companies. He even confessed, to some audible gasps in the courtroom, that his own AI company, xAI, which makes the chatbot Grok, uses OpenAI’s models to train its own. The federal courthouse in Oakland, California, was packed with armies of lawyers carrying boxes of exhibits, journalists typing away at their laptops, and a handful of concerned OpenAI employees. Outside, protesters lined the streets, carrying signs urging people to quit ChatGPT, boycott Tesla, or both. Musk looked calm and comfortable, slipping in the occasional quip in his distinct South African accent. But he also was full of remorse. “I was a fool who provided them free funding to create a startup,” Musk told the jury. He said when he cofounded OpenAI in 2015 with Altman and Brockman, he was donating to a nonprofit developing AI for the benefit of humanity, not to make the executives rich. “I gave them $38 million of essentially free funding, which they then used to create what would become an $800 billion company,” he said. Musk is asking the court to remove Altman and Brockman from their roles and to unwind the restructuring that allowed OpenAI t…
summary: 马斯克诉 OpenAI 案首周庭审中，马斯克承认其 AI 公司 xAI 蒸馏了 OpenAI 的模型，并警告 AI 可能毁灭人类。法庭还披露了马斯克挖角 OpenAI 员工、以及 OpenAI 早期依赖黄仁勋捐赠超算等细节。此案揭示了硅谷巨头间的激烈竞争与复杂利益关系。

title: Claude Security is now in public beta
raw_excerpt: Claude Security, now in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers, leverages the powerful Opus 4.7 model to identify and patch software vulnerabilities. The model, integrated into tools used by partners like Microsoft Security and Palo Alto Networks, enhances cybersecurity defenses by enabling efficient, ongoing code scanning without requiring custom API integration. Feedback from hundreds of organizations has refined its capabilities.
summary: Anthropic 推出 Claude Security 公开测试版，面向 Claude Enterprise 客户。该工具基于 Opus 4.7 模型，可自动识别和修复软件漏洞，已集成至 Microsoft Security 和 Palo Alto Networks 等合作伙伴工具中。此举将 AI 安全能力从被动防御提升为主动代码审计，降低企业安全运营成本。

title: xAI has launched Grok 4.3
raw_excerpt: Grok 4.3 improves on cost-per-intelligence relative to Grok 4.20 0309 v2. It scores higher on the Intelligence Index while costing less to run the full benchmark suite. Grok 4.3 is one of the lowest-cost models at its intelligence level. It performs strongly on instruction following and agentic customer support tasks.
summary: xAI 发布 Grok 4.3 模型，在 Intelligence Index 上得分更高，同时推理成本更低。该模型在指令遵循和智能客服任务上表现突出，是当前同智能水平下成本最低的模型之一。Grok 4.3 的推出进一步加剧了大模型性价比竞争。

title: Qwen-Scope: Decoding Intelligence, Unleashing Potential
raw_excerpt: Qwen-Scope is an interpretability toolkit trained on the Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 series models. The toolkit sheds light on the internal mechanisms underlying Qwen's behavior and holds potential for model optimization. It can be used for controllable inference, data classification and synthesis, model training and optimization, and evaluation sample distribution analysis.
summary: 阿里云发布 Qwen-Scope 可解释性工具包，基于 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 系列模型训练。该工具可揭示模型内部机制，支持可控推理、数据分类与合成、模型训练优化及评估样本分布分析。Qwen-Scope 为开源社区提供了深入理解大模型行为的重要工具。

title: Microsoft wants lawyers to trust its new AI agent in Word documents
raw_excerpt: Microsoft is launching a new AI agent inside Word that's specifically designed for legal teams. Legal Agent handles document edits, negotiation history, and complex documents to help legal teams handle tasks like reviewing contracts. "Instead of relying on general AI models to interpret commands, the agent follows structured workflows shaped by real legal practice, managing clearly defined, repeatable tasks like reviewing contracts clause by clause against a playbook," explains Sumit Chauhan , corporate vice president of Microsoft's Office Product Group. summary: 微软在 Word 中推出 Legal Agent，专为法律团队设计，可处理合同审查、文档编辑和谈判历史等任务。该代理遵循结构化工作流，而非依赖通用 AI 模型解释指令，能逐条对照规则审查合同。此举标志着 AI 助手向垂直专业领域深度渗透。

title: Meta收购机器人AI公司，加速布局人形机器人技术
raw_excerpt: Meta Platforms已完成对机器人人工智能初创公司Assured Robot Intelligence的收购，以加速其人形机器人技术的研发进程。该收购于5月1日完成，具体财务条款未予披露。Assured Robot Intelligence专注于为机器人开发AI模型，其技术旨在使机器人能够在复杂动态环境中理解、预测并适应人类行为。Meta发言人表示，该初创公司“处于机器人智能的前沿领域”。（新浪财经）
summary: Meta 收购机器人 AI 初创公司 Assured Robot Intelligence，加速人形机器人技术研发。该公司专注于为机器人开发能在复杂动态环境中理解、预测并适应人类行为的 AI 模型。Meta 此举表明其正从社交平台向实体 AI 领域扩张，人形机器人赛道竞争加剧。

title: Uber torches 2026 AI budget on Claude Code in four months
summary: 据内部消息，Uber 在短短四个月内将 2026 年全部 AI 预算用于 Claude Code，导致后续项目资金枯竭。这一事件凸显了企业对 AI 编码助手的高昂需求与预算管理之间的冲突，也反映出 Claude Code 在工程团队中的实际渗透率远超预期。
